name: Berstetz Fondalfon
japaneseName: ベルステツ・フォンダルフォン
description: Berstetz Fondalfon is the Prime Minister of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the second-in-command after the Emperor in terms of political power. He was one of the masterminds behind the Imperial Civil War in Arc 7, and later played a supporting role in Arc 8.
